questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A body of mass 2 kg is lifted vertically through a height of 5 m. The work done against gravity (take g = 10 m s⁻²) is:
questions.explanation: W = mgh = 2 × 10 × 5 = 100 J, which is stored as gravitational potential energy.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 5: Work, Energy and Power

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: For a satellite revolving very close to the Earth's surface, the escape velocity vₑ and the orbital velocity v₀ are related as:
questions.explanation: v₀ = √(gR) and vₑ = √(2gR), so vₑ = √2 v₀, giving about 11.2 km s⁻¹ against roughly 7.9 km s⁻¹.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In a p-type semiconductor obtained by doping silicon with a trivalent impurity, the majority charge carriers are:
questions.explanation: A trivalent dopant such as boron creates vacancies, so holes are the majority carriers and electrons the minority carriers.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The formation of ammonia, N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃, is exothermic. Raising the temperature at equilibrium will:
questions.explanation: By Le Chatelier's principle, heating an exothermic equilibrium favours the backward endothermic direction, so less ammonia forms and Kp falls.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: On the basis of standard electrode potentials, which of the following is the strongest reducing agent?
questions.explanation: Lithium has the most negative standard reduction potential (about -3.05 V), so it loses electrons most readily and is the strongest reducing agent.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Heating ethanol with excess concentrated sulphuric acid at 443 K chiefly gives:
questions.explanation: At the higher temperature of 443 K intramolecular dehydration dominates and gives ethene; at about 413 K diethyl ether is formed instead.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 7: Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Secondary growth in the stem of a dicot plant is brought about mainly by:
questions.explanation: The lateral vascular cambium cuts off secondary xylem inwards and secondary phloem outwards, increasing the girth of the stem.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 6: Anatomy of Flowering Plants

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Which class of enzymes is used to cut DNA at specific recognition sequences during gene cloning?
questions.explanation: Restriction endonucleases recognise palindromic sequences and cut within the DNA to leave sticky ends, which ligase then joins.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 9: Biotechnology: Principles and Processes

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: How many functional spermatozoa are finally formed from one primary spermatocyte?
questions.explanation: One primary spermatocyte gives two secondary spermatocytes after meiosis I and four spermatids after meiosis II, all of which mature into sperms.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Antidiuretic hormone (vasopressin) reduces urine output mainly by acting on the:
questions.explanation: ADH makes the distal tubule and collecting duct more permeable to water, so more water is reabsorbed and concentrated urine is passed.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 16: Excretory Products and their Elimination
